extracted.name: Crunchies
extracted.description: These cookies are similar to Anzac biscuits, but are not as hard. They are very quick to make, and go down well with a cup of tea.
instruction_lines: Boil butter or margarine and syrup together. Add soda. You should end up with a frothy mixture after soda is added. Stir in coconut, flour, sugar, and oats, and stir well. Press mixture lightly into a large baking tray.
Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 15 minutes. Cool, and cut into bars.
